chapter_title_en: The Trials of the Divine Palace
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 362 – Ji Ning Chooses Battle: The Divine Palace Trials
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning explores the Divine Palace of Immortals and discovers the true price of learning its arts: years of labor or a battle of pure Dao against a legendary puppet.
og_title: The Chore Master vs. The Puppet Fighter: Ji Ning’s Defining Choice
og_description: Our hero picks a fight with a sixth-level puppet that purely tests his Sword Dao. The real training begins now.
twitter_title: The Divine Palace isn't a library, it's a gauntlet.
twitter_description: Ji Ning discovers the classic Xianxia choice: sweep a path for a thousand years or prove your Dao with a single perfect sword stroke. Guess which one he picks.

lore_anchors.definition: The lower library and trial ground of Mount Innerheart, containing countless techniques from the primordial era to the present, accessible only through designated service or combat trials.
The white-robed steward of the Divine Palace of Immortals and an elder disciple of Patriarch Subhuti who guides Ji Ning through the Palace’s rules.
A method of learning techniques by performing manual labor chores of increasing scope and duration, from sweeping a path to a thousand years of gate-keeping.
A method of learning techniques by defeating specially-created puppets that test pure Dao comprehension, forbidding the use of divine abilities or formations.
The highest treasure hall of Mount Innerheart, accessible only to personal disciples or those who have mastered the ninth floor of the Divine Palace of Immortals.
